title: pleurothallis divexa
intro: Pleurothallis divexa, commonly known as the "divexa orchid," is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is native to Central and South America, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions. The health benefits of Pleurothallis divexa are not extensively documented, however, it is believed to have potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which could be beneficial for wound healing and skin conditions.
